timing_interpretation: Stage totals overlap nested subphases. point_model_validation is inside restore_point_verify; do not sum both. Git operations are nested in caller stages. Last old/final cycle persistence return is unknown, not zero. First new persistence is measured by a later natural cycle.
finding: Restore-point model validation was the largest separately measured subphase: 219.117771 seconds, 54.14% of 404.697237 seconds bundle restore. The start gap improved 57.982123 seconds against October 23, but completion gap increased 16.012284 seconds and start gap was 20.627553 seconds longer than October 22. This is not a claim that total interruptions are solved.

No cancellation, rerun, manual dispatch or additional cycle. Keep historical packages and checkpoint format compatible.

limitations: No raw public Actions logs or broker objects used. Exit-code annotations do not identify root cause.
